text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race. The moment I opened the 
waiting room door to call Duramente— a 
piercing atmosphere ran right through me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—Hm, is it already post time? You could 
have simply called out to me.”
choice_data_list:
You were so focused, and your spirit was 
incredible, so...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I was doing some visualization 
training in order to become the 
"strongest" in the race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I've got a good feel for it now. All 
that's left is to prove it with my own 
ability.
